program_solutions:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g))
                (rseps (filter (lambda (r)
                                 (all? (lambda (c) (zero? (at g r c))) (range 0 w)))
                               (range 0 h)))
                (cseps (filter (lambda (c)
                                 (all? (lambda (r) (zero? (at g r c))) (range 0 h)))
                               (range 0 w))))
           (define (spans seps limit)
             (let loop
                  ((xs seps) (start 0) (acc (list)))
                  (if (empty? xs)
                      (reverse (if (< start limit)
                                   (cons (list start (- limit 1)) acc)
                                   acc))
                      (let* ((sep (fst xs)))
                        (loop (cdr xs)
                              (+ sep 1)
                              (if (< start sep) (cons (list start (- sep 1)) acc) acc))))))
           (define rbands (spans rseps h))
           (define cbands (spans cseps w))
           (define tiles
             (filter (lambda (tile) (!= (third tile) 0))
                     (flatmap (lambda (rb)
                                (map (lambda (cb) (list rb cb (at g (fst rb) (fst cb))))
                                     cbands))
                              rbands)))
           (define (has-offset? color dr dc)
             (any? (lambda (tile)
                     (let* ((rb (fst tile))
                            (cb (snd tile))
                            (r (+ (fst rb) dr))
                            (c (+ (fst cb) dc)))
                       (and
                         (in-bounds? r c h w)
                         (= (third tile) color)
                         (= (at g r c) color))))
                   tiles))
           (reduce (lambda (acc tile)
                     (let* ((rb (fst tile))
                            (cb (snd tile))
                            (color (third tile))
                            (r0 (fst rb))
                            (r1 (snd rb))
                            (c0 (fst cb))
                            (c1 (snd cb))
                            (offsets (flatmap (lambda (dr)
                                                (map (lambda (dc) (list dr dc))
                                                     (range 0 (+ 1 (- c1 c0)))))
                                              (range 0 (+ 1 (- r1 r0))))))
                       (reduce (lambda (a off)
                                 (let* ((dr (fst off))
                                        (dc (snd off)))
                                   (if (has-offset? color dr dc)
                                       (set-cell a (+ r0 dr) (+ c0 dc) color)
                                       a)))
                               acc
                               offsets)))
                   g
                   tiles))))
